description_en: The OnsMessagePush operation pushes a message to a specified consumer
description_zh: 调用OnsMessagePush向指定的消费者推送消息
kebab_example: aliyun ons ons-message-push --group-id GID_test_group_id --client-id '30.5.121.00@24813#-1999745829#-1737591554#453111174894656' --msg-id 0BC1669963053CF68F733BB703960000 --topic test-mq_topic --region cn-hangzhou
name: OnsMessagePush

parameters.help_en: The group ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29533.html
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the consumer instance. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29598.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh: 消费者实例的ID。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29598.html接口获取该ID
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The topic to which the message is pushed
parameters.name: topic

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance that contains the message that you want to push
parameters.help_zh: 所需推送的消息所在的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. Use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
